name: move_forward
description: Continuously moves the robot forward while this action is active.

name: move_backward
description: Continuously moves the robot backward while this action is active.

name: strafe_left
description: Continuously strafes the robot to the left while this action is active.

name: strafe_right
description: Continuously strafes the robot to the right while this action is active.

name: turn_left
description: Continuously rotates the robot to the left while this action is active.

name: turn_right
description: Continuously rotates the robot to the right while this action is active.

name: rotateToCenterBackpack
description: Continuously rotates the robot until the backpack is centered in the camera frame.

name: stop
description: Stops all robot motion by sending a zero-velocity command. Use this when the robot has completed a movement phase, reached the final goal, detected an emergency condition, or needs to safely pause.
